title: [Bank. Acc. Reconciliation with Copilot] Implement ability to switch LLM with a simple configuration change
summary: Bank Account Reconciliation with Copilot now supports switching between different LLM models through Key Vault configuration without code changes, and improves parser robustness to handle variations in model output formatting.
key_points: New GetChatCompletionsDeployment() method reads Key Vault secret to select between GPT-5.6 Ceres or GPT-4.1 models
Deployment name added as custom dimension to telemetry events for audit and incident tracking
Parser logic strengthened to handle formatting variations like spacing differences and bracketed text across both statement matching and transfer-to-G/L-account features
Default behavior unchanged when Key Vault secret is missing or blank
Both matching and G/L account proposal parsers now share common helper methods for consistent handling
quote: Makes the model switchable through Key Vault, so we can move to GPT-5.6 Ceres once it passes DSB review without shipping code.
